name: InterroBot
blurb: InterroBot provides the website crawler, search, and analysis you need to understand your website.
description:
InterroBot provides the website crawler, search, and analysis you
need to understand your website. It's the perfect tool for managing CMS,
improving SEO, or troubleshooting web development.

Get a full-featured, 14-day trial for free. InterroBot will
continue to run as Community Edition (with a limited set of crawler
options) after the trial expires. InterroBot is proprietary software,
but free to use and distribute.

Web Developers. Search beyond the keywords. InterroBot
filters CSS class, JavaScript and image src usage, HTTP headers, errors,
download size, response times, and more...

CMS Administrators. Settle into a new paradigm—website
omniscience. Solve vague end-user reports with InterroBot search. Never
miss a reference update again.

SEO Specialists. Comprehensive search smokes out HTTP
errors, redirection, and keyword coverage issues negatively affecting
SERP-standing.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
